description: This file contains unit tests for the FrontPanel component using Google Test framework. It includes test classes and methods that verify the behavior of FrontPanel functionalities such as setting and getting brightness, power LED control, clock settings, and LED configurations through mocked dependencies.

classes.description: Test fixture for basic FrontPanel tests, initializes plugin and handler.

classes.description: Further setup including IARM bus mocks and event handlers for tests that require system initialization.

classes.description: Extends previous with mock services and event dispatching for event-related tests.

classes.name: FrontPanelInitializedEventDsTest
classes.description: Specialized class setting color mocks and simulating system events for detailed front panel behavior tests.
